description: Kept Friday and Saturday off Sunday's paper, and shut the lid.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Already up. Not praised into waiting for another break.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Kept the green from becoming a second hall, and took Nick as far as the stair.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Not on the green. Her laugh was not told a second time.
name: Queen Elizabeth

description: Kept the chair's laugh from becoming a wage, and claimed his side of the bed.
name: George Bryan

description: Not in the hall. His leave was the reason the jig was played.
name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon

description: Entered nothing, and kept the cloaks for morning.
name: John Heminges

description: Walked without singing, and said good night.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Left the bow as it was, and stopped looking.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Named as carrying what he is given, and not searching.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Took the old play once, and would not help the laugh.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Held the story, and said this inn did not qualify.
name: Will Kemp

description: Refused a path-side lesson, took the middle of the bed, and went in.
name: William Shakespeare
